expected: An unmeasured gain of roughly +5–8 percentage points; the main risks are losing the fourth independent sample and introducing hidden regressions during correction.
hypothesis: Replacing the final sample and judge with a Sol review followed by a Luna correction will raise all-pass by repairing shared defects that candidate selection cannot fix.
mechanism: Generate three independent Luna files, then have Sol select and audit a public-green baseline against the entire specification, including defects shared by every candidate. Luna implements only confirmed corrections; the baseline survives if the edit fails public tests. Review and correction are one coupled replacement for the incumbent’s last two calls: feedback needs an implementation call to affect the submitted file. The no-green path remains unchanged.
